notes.title: Aeromancer – Character Backstory
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

We’re excited to share the last installment (for now) of our character backstory series – highlighting the [b]Aeromancer[/b] class.

A skilled mercenary who fought in the war against Azuria, the Aeromancer is quite familiar with enemy territory! He spent quite a bit of time there when the Fall occurred – though he managed to escape in the darkness before the country froze over. Soon after, he was recruited to join other mages and help search for mana crystals. 

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900044/6721313a39f6965e057876d0423c82da3b034d80.png[/img]

He’s practical, intelligent, and is very to the point – which is to be expected from such an experienced soldier! A very pragmatic character to have on your team. 

Thank you for checking out our character backstories! There are other classes we hope to implement in the future – and when we do, we’ll definitely share more about their stories :) 

If you missed any of our previous posts, check out the backstories for the [b]Geomancer[/b], [b]Pyromancer[/b], and [b]Hydromancer[/b]! And if you have any questions, don’t hesitate to let us know in the Discussion Threads.

– Mystic Interactive

notes.title: Pyromancer – Character Backstory
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

We’re excited to share more about the four playable classes available in [i]Crystal Conquest[/i]! This week, we’re highlighting the Pyromancer. 

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900044/191b972c3546ec102f61c1e1cf57746ad7cc459d.png[/img]

A star performer from a world-renowned magical circus, the [b]Pyromancer [/b]is a damage dealer that excels at area damage, but has a limited defense. Despite her serious appearance, she’s actually quite reckless – with a bubbly disposition. She’s eager to fight and sometimes even charges into battle without even thinking about the consequences … 

Looking forward to learning about the Geomancer and Aeromancer? Stay tuned for our next update :) 

– Mystic Interactive

notes.title: Hydromancer – Character Backstory
notes.content:
Hi Everyone! 

Crystal Conquest features four playable classes (for now!) – but did you know that each one has a unique backstory? 

Our Hydromancer hails from the Southern Kingdoms, which erupted into civil war after the Fall of Magic. Like many mages, she journeyed to the Lost Continent in search of mana crystals. Her goal was simple: Gain power to heal the sick and injured. 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44900044/f75fd7546f76d72189366068319e89e845e0fc2f.png[/img]

Unfortunately, not everyone shared her lofty goals. After arriving at the Lost Continent, the peace-loving Hydromancer was forced to pick a side – and fight to survive. 

Eager to learn about the other classes? Keep an eye out for our next update!

– Mystic Interactive

notes.title: The Ludold Leyline
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We have more to share about [i]Crystal Conquest[/i]’s backstory:

After generations of relying on mana-powered technology, many nations of Eridea suffered greatly from the Fall of Magic. Even worse, the Winter of Despair sent harsh frosts that reached even the southern nations. Harvests failed and food shortages ensued. Restoring magic seemed like the only hope for humanity’s survival. 

A few surviving mages then discovered that they could draw limited amounts of power from mana crystals. Magic was partially restored – to those who could afford the crystals. However, individual crystals could not begin to solve worldwide cold and hunger. 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44900044/f40186954233b79127a3b3b2995726ca2147bc16.png[/img]

Hope sprang from an unexpected discovery on the Lost Continent: The Ludold Leyline. This power source held enormous mana crystals sufficient to power the magical needs of an entire nation. 

Unable or unwilling to divide the crystals fairly, two magical factions began to fight over the Ludold Leyline. This conflict became known as the [i]Crystal Conquest[/i]. 

~ Mystic Interactive

notes.title: Forbidden Magic
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Continuing our series on [i]Crystal Conquest[/i] lore: 

The Fall of Magic caused the war for mana crystals – but what caused the Fall? 

Eleven years into their conflict with a rival empire, the northern nation of Azuria resorted to forbidden magic. Azurian mages tapped deep into the earth’s mana, summoning a vast meteor shower. This calamity destroyed the rival empire in minutes – and severed humanity’s link from magic. 

The meteor shower also doomed Azuria itself: Clouds of soot blotted out the sun and began the Winter of Despair. Freezing and unable to harness magical solutions, the northern nation collapsed. 

Azuria was not the only country to suffer from both the Fall of Magic and Winter of Despair. Even southern nations found themselves in desperate straits … 

We’ll reveal more backstory in our next post!

~ Mystic Interactive

notes.title: From 1v1 Duel to 3v3 MOBA
notes.content:
Fun fact: [i]Crystal Conquest[/i] began as a 1v1 game that our Founder, Sean, developed in his spare time. How did we go from a side project called “Duel” to a 3v3 MOBA?

Sean realized that he wanted to truly innovate VR by creating fun multiplayer experiences. So, he took the strategic elements of “Duel,” started working on it full time, and hired the first Mystic Interactive employee. Now we need community input! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pNQxdx7.gif[/img]

To truly push the VR envelope, we need your feedback. That’s why we’re so excited to launch in Early Access and hear your thoughts :)

What do you want from a 3v3 MOBA? Should it become a 5v5 MOBA? What character classes do you want to see? Please share! 

~ The Mystic Interactive Team

notes.title: That’s no moon – that’s a MOBA!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We just wanted to share more about [i]Crystal Conquest[/i]’s backstory with you all :) 

[i]Crystal Conquest[/i] takes place on a moon called Eridea, where societal progress was greatly accelerated by magic. Unfortunately, The Fall of Magic occurred – an event where people lost access to the source of their magical power! Soon after this event, the mages discovered mana crystals and magic could be restored.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44900044/38d63fbda9bd6501e0819edbf6720dfb80da19ef.jpg[/img]

Once considered a curiosity, these crystals are the world’s last hope for magical power. Each nation has sent its best mages to claim the crystals for themselves – resulting in all-out magical warfare. 

This conflict has shaped each character in [i]Crystal Conquest[/i]. Stay tuned as we reveal more about their motivations, personalities, and goals!

~ Mystic Interactive
